productUrls.title: Product or Store URLs
productUrls.description: Direct product page URLs (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, or any Schema.org/JSON-LD store).

targetPriceThreshold.title: Target Alert Price Threshold
targetPriceThreshold.description: Optional price ceiling. If the extracted product price is equal to or below this value, priceAlertTriggered is set to true.

webhookUrl.title: Alert Webhook URL (Slack / Discord / n8n / Make)
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTP POST webhook endpoint triggered whenever a price alert or stock change occurs.

tryShopifyJsonEndpoint.title: Use Fast Shopify .json API When Available
tryShopifyJsonEndpoint.description: Automatically probes the native Shopify product JSON endpoint for full variant-level inventory and SKU accuracy.
